subject: general
question: Who presented the Union Budget 2024-25 in the Parliament on 23 July 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ms. Nirmala Sitharaman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ms. Nirmala Sitharaman** is the current **Minister of Finance** and **Minister of Corporate Affairs** of India.
 
• She has been serving as the Finance Minister of India since **May 2019**.
 
• Ms. Sitharaman is the first full-time female Finance Minister of India.
 
• She presented the Union Budget 2024-25 in the Parliament on **23 July 2024**.
 
• The Union Budget is an annual financial statement presented by the Government of India, outlining its estimated revenue and expenditure for the upcoming fiscal year.
 
• Her tenure has seen significant economic policies and reforms aimed at boosting the Indian economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw**__

 __
 
• Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw is the **Minister of Railways**, **Communications**, and **Electronics & Information Technology** of India.
 
• He has held these positions since **July 2021**.
 
 
 
• **Shri Bhupender Yadav**__
 __
 
• Shri Bhupender Yadav is the **Minister of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** and **Minister of Labour and Employment** of India.
 
• He has been serving in these roles since **July 2021**.
 
 
 
• **Shri Shaktikanta Das**__
 
 
• Shri Shaktikanta Das is the current **Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**.
 
• He has been serving as the RBI Governor since **December 2018**.
